Chapter: The Interborough Express at Avenue I
Description: A 14-mile light rail line connecting Brooklyn and Queens along an existing freight corridor. Our research site: where it meets the F train at Avenue I / McDonald Avenue.
The Bay Ridge Branch carries a handful of freight trains a day through dense residential Brooklyn — a rail line most neighbors have never ridden.
The F stops here on the McDonald Avenue elevated. IBX would add a transfer below, turning a one-line stop into a crosstown hub.
